newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela foreign reserves fall to $16.085 bln. [CORRECTED 18:51 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Venezuela foreign reserves fall to $16.085 bln. [CORRECTED 18:51 GMT]

text.p: Venezuela's total foreign reserves fell $69 million, or 0.4 (corrects from 0.004) percent, in the week to June 16 to $16.085 billion, according to new figures released by the central bank.
Reserves were down from $16.154 billion on June 9, the bank's latest weekly bulletin of indicators showed.

Since the start of the year, reserves have risen $906 million, or 6.0 percent. Reserves rose $5.5 billion, or 57 percent, last year to $15.179 billion and government officials have forecast they will grow to $20 billion by the end of 1997.
